content: Streak calculation pitfalls: (1) server-time vs user-local-time mismatch on 'what day is today' near midnight; (2) DST arithmetic checks like 'elapsed >= 24h' break on both spring-forward (23h day passes early) and fall-back (25h day passes late) — fix is calendar-date STRING comparison, not hour-duration math; (3) grace periods (3-6h) after local midnight reduce false streak breaks; (4) SQL gaps-and-islands pattern (row_number() subtracted from date, or LAG+cumulative-SUM flag) is the standard efficient approach, more efficient than recursive CTEs for grouping consecutive days.
